name: com.gameframex.godot.event
description:
GameFrameX Event — Godot type-identified event bus package. Supports subscribe/unsubscribe with string IDs, thread-safe deferred dispatching (Fire, delivered next frame on main thread), immediate synchronous dispatching (FireNow), and default handler fallback for unhandled events.

GameFrameX Event — Godot 类型化事件总线功能包。支持基于字符串 ID 的订阅/取消订阅，线程安全的延迟分发（Fire，下一帧主线程投递）、即时同步分发（FireNow），以及未处理事件的默认处理器兜底。文档：https://gameframex.doc.alianblank.com
